Provide Light and Dark Mode images
to make certain content show up in light vs. dark mode. By default items are shown in light mode, so here is how you can control light vs. dark behavior:
To only show in dark mode
. This hides the element by default, and sets its display to
when the Dark theme is active.
To only show in light mode
. The element will be hidden when Dark mode is active.

For example, here is how you can make two elements swap visibility during light and dark mode. This is useful if you have two versions of an image that are meant for light and dark modes, but the same approach could be applied to any element you can

:::{div}
:class: hidden dark:block
The theme is dark.
:::

:::{div}
:class: dark:hidden
The theme is light.
:::
This will only work if you’re using the default themes
, which comes with the default themes. If you’re using a custom
theme, these classes may not work.
